product_overview: LibraLink is a web-based library management system that lets guests browse the public catalog, borrowers manage reservations through an authenticated portal, and librarians handle circulation tasks. It supports core library workflows such as login, catalog discovery, checkout/checkin operations, and reservation requests.
core_goals: Browse the public book catalog and inspect book details
Authenticate into the appropriate borrower or librarian portal
Process book checkout and checkin actions for patrons
Reserve books that are currently unavailable
Access role-specific dashboards after signing in

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows a user to sign in with email and password to access the appropriate authenticated area.
user_flows: Navigate to /login.php -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See dashboard

features.name: Browse Catalog
features.description: Lets guests and users search the public catalog and view book information.
user_flows: Navigate to /catalog.php -> Enter search term in input field -> Click search button -> View book details

features.name: Librarian Circulation
features.description: Allows authenticated librarians to manually check books out to borrowers or process returns and receive a receipt confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to /librarian/index.php -> Enter user ID -> Enter book ID -> Click Checkout or Checkin -> View receipt modal

features.name: Borrower Reservations
features.description: Allows authenticated borrowers to reserve books that are currently checked out and confirm the reservation request.
user_flows: Navigate to /borrower/index.php -> Search for a book that is out of stock -> Click Reserve button -> Confirm reservation
